Locally based role — work from Kalgoorlie with the Goldfields as your backyard  Senior leadership position with genuine responsibility and influence  Supportive team culture with a strong focus on safety and continuous improvement  Opportunity to shape the growth of the business in the region      If you're an experienced Operations and Works Leader, ready to take on a high-impact role wiht a capable and ambitious team, we'd love to hear from you.
